first.folds: Five fixed training-only folds, identical across portfolios and the native regularized reference.

package_variants.stronger: 15 configurations shared by explicit regularized/forest/boosting learners, one_se rule.

reference_models.xgboost: 400 rounds, eta .05, depth 3, min_child_weight 1, row/column fraction .8, lambda 1, alpha 0.
reference_models.ranger: 500 trees, default mtry and node size, probability forests for classification.
reference_models.glmnet: Alpha 1, full default lambda path, fixed training folds, lambda.1se.

first.exclusions: No test-based hyperparameters, score thresholds, feature selection, resampling, or case filtering.

metadata.unknown_values: The donor's literal unknown category is retained.
